item.title: Exercise Session Leader
item.description:
Personally recommended by the lecturer of Discrete Mathematics & Algorithms to the Head of the Mathematics Department, and hand-picked as 1 of only 3 students trusted to lead weekly exercise sessions for first-year students.

item.title: Cashier
item.description:
• Worked part-time at one of Karlskrona’s busy and well-reviewed locations, primarily supporting the lunch rush, when maintaining fast and consistent service was essential.
  • Key responsibilities:
    • Prepared ingredients and products for sale before opening, ensuring sufficient stock for the day.
    • Cleaned and prepared the store, ensuring hygiene and service quality standards were met before opening.
    • Welcomed customers, helped them choose items, and handled special requests.
    • Processed payments and transactions accurately and efficiently while keeping the checkout area and store clean and organized.
    • Assisted with preparing, packing, and handing over food orders to customers.
    • Cleaned, washed dishes, and maintained the cleanliness of the store before the end of the lunch shift.

item.title: Preschool Childcare Worker
item.description:
Preschool Childcare Worker · Rödeby Förskola Tallbacken · Sep 2022 – Aug 2024

  • Key responsibilities:
    • Planned and delivered daily activities for the children, supporting their physical and emotional well-being while developing social skills and cooperation
    • Collaborated with the team to plan and implement educational activities adapted to each child’s individual needs, abilities, and developmental stage.
    • Monitored, documented, and updated information on children’s development in individual records.
    • Earned colleagues’ trust to independently plan and organize activities for the group, prepare activity reports, and communicate important updates to parents through weekly newsletters.
    • Communicated with parents regarding children’s development and progress, while supporting colleagues with planning and group management.
  • In addition to regular responsibilities, was selected by the school management to participate in planning and managing summer operations during the consolidation of three preschools into one due to a decline in the number of children.

Substitute Preschool Childcare Worker · Karlskrona Kommun · May 2022 – Aug 2022

item.title: Vietnam Maritime Commercial Joint Stock Bank
item.description:
Banking Operations Specialist · Sep 2017 – Oct 2019

  • Key responsibilities:

    • Advised, supported, and handled operational queries from tellers and controllers across the bank via email, phone, and the Operation Service Desk.
    • Drafted and developed process descriptions and governing documents for the bank’s operational activities.
    • Reviewed process descriptions and governing documents prepared by other departments and provided feedback and suggestions for improvement.
    • Designed training materials and delivered training sessions on banking procedures and operations.

  • In addition, I was selected as one of two specialists from our team to be responsible for the process work in a bank-wide transformation project, which involved moving the entire Customer Service function from Operations to Retail Banking. I was responsible for drafting and developing process descriptions and governing documents, as well as participating in training to ensure a smooth and comprehensive transition. I also took full responsibility for designing and preparing a monthly newsletter covering the bank’s processes and important operational updates, which was distributed across the bank. Furthermore, I was assigned to consolidate documentation and participate in discussions on designing more effective working hours for the Customer Service function to maximize operational efficiency.

item.title: General Accountant
item.description:

    • Opened bank accounts for the company and its employees and handled banking transactions.
    • Completed insurance registration procedures for all company employees.
    • Planned and purchased supplies and equipment required for the company’s operations.
    • Prepared and submitted tax reports to the tax authorities.
    • Prepared internal reports for the Management Board.
    • Maintained and managed real estate records, employee records, and recruitment documentation.

item.title: Home
item.description:
Thanh Chu

Software Engineering Student — Building on 15+ Years of Cross-Industry Experience

Software Engineering student at Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH), Sweden, who ships working full-stack applications end-to-end. Delivered a production-grade monitoring framework for Ericsson that earned direct praise from the client team for technical quality, initiative, and professionalism — shaped by a career that already spans banking operations and early-childhood education.
See My CV

About me

My path into software wasn't a straight line: eight years in banking operations in Vietnam, two years teaching preschool in Sweden, and now a Software Engineering degree at BTH — each stage sharpening a different edge I bring to a dev team.

What that looks like in practice: I was trusted to co-own a bank-wide system migration before I ever wrote a line of production code, and I carried that same ownership into my first real engineering project — a monitoring framework built for Ericsson that earned direct praise from their team for technical quality and initiative. BTH's Mathematics Department later hand-picked me as 1 of just 3 students to lead exercise sessions for first-year students.

Day to day, that means backend services, databases, CI/CD, monitoring, and containerised deployments — learned fast, and owned end-to-end.

Technical Skills
